_comment: Registry of services redeployed when this repo's main branch changes, via Zeabur's GraphQL redeployService mutation. Order matters: 'canary' redeploys first and gates everything after it. service_id/environment_id are Zeabur identifiers (not secrets) — get them from the Zeabur GraphQL API/Apollo Explorer. Authentication is a single ZEABUR_API_TOKEN GitHub Actions secret, not per-service. See .github/workflows/propagate.yml for setup.
